Callout.Name: Person in Crisis
Callout.Message: Caller worried about a person who has threatened to harm themselves.
Callout.Advisory: Person on foot, no weapon, no crime reported.

Script.Line: I do not want to talk to anybody. I want to be left alone.
I have not done anything wrong. I am sat in my own flat.
You are the fourth person today. The fourth.

Lines.Approach: Nobody has committed an offence here. He is on his own and somebody has to talk to him.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
